'''Don Weinstein''' was the event organizer of the [[2004 DPC Carolina]], the North Carolina DeckTech Player's Challenge weekend of 22–24 October 2004 at Fallen Orc Games in Cary, North Carolina, and a [[The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game|LOTR TCG]] judge.<ref name="pc-dpccar">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/DPC%20Carolina%202004.htm North Carolina - DeckTech Player's Challenge - SWCCG Worlds Qualifier], swccgpc.com (October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041216042614/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/DPC%20Carolina%202004.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
